packageRules.description: A pin changes nothing that could age: Renovate 42 treats a missing release timestamp as 'not old enough', so pin PRs otherwise sit on a pending stability check forever
Reusable workflows are consumed from @main on purpose; a digest pin freezes a repo on an old revision and turns every workflow change into a per-repo PR

Every repo declaring phpunit/phpunit is on ^9.6 against wp-phpunit ~7.x and yoast/phpunit-polyfills ^4.0, which still call PHPUnit\Util\Test::parseTestMethodAnnotations(), removed in PHPUnit 11 — plus a MockObject method()/expects() signature break. horizontal-scroll-for-elementor#24 is the proof (52 failing integration tests). Cap below v11 fleet-wide until a coordinated bump (wp-phpunit + phpunit-polyfills + call-site fixes) ships as separate work.
